tutorial.trickDisplay: This is the current trick. You must follow the led suit; when void you may play any card. Each contract punishes a different set of penalty cards.

tutorial.info: King is a Greek/Brazilian compendium of trick-avoidance games. Four players share a 52-card deck over exactly seven deals. Each deal the dealer picks one of seven unused contracts, then all seats play thirteen must-follow tricks. After all seven deals, the highest total score (fewest penalties) wins.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
